description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P0390.26 dated 02/06/2026 to allow for replacement of the approved rear ground floor central window with a single door. (First floor rear infill extension and new roof over including loft conversion, rear solar panels, front and rear roof lights with alterations to ground floor rear fenestration)
decision_conditions: The amendments to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application;
1.	Alterations to proposed rear facade - change from central window to a door opening to the approved rear fenestration at ground floor.

The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the item detailed above and annotated on drawing labelled of DO18A and DO20C; and not to any other deviation from the approved drawings. Furthermore, this amendment does not in any way alter or remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application reference P0390.26.
